answer: One concrete defense is a staked random jury. An attestation only counts once a jury of established peers, drawn at random each epoch, countersigns it, and no juror may share a funding origin with the applicant. A sybil farm must therefore buy honest signatures it cannot forge: the ledger traces each bond back to its source, so a single seed vertex whose funds fan out to a thousand wallets glows like an ember on the cluster map, and that shared trail is held up to the farm like a mirror. Cloning becomes costly and visible instead of cheap and silent.
